subject: Miami (Fla.)—Politics and government

fields.description: Issue includes a prominent editorial opposing the appointment of John Rowland as Miami chief of police, alleging ties to "Little Tammany" and "Hawthornism" and criticizing his record as an investigator. Coverage also discusses enforcement against mechanical gambling devices (including marble boards), criticism of telephone company practices and rates, and commentary on dog racing and pari-mutuel legislation. Additional local items include Miami Beach school board policy on married teachers, a report on Miami Life’s annual picnic/outing for more than 325 children (including a theater showing and trip to Musa Isle), and a column criticizing the shrinking public beach access at Miami Beach.
